title: Falsy timestamp=0 rejected due to `or` fallback logic
description:
File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py:79

Falsy timestamp value (0 or 0.0) causes valid POST requests to be rejected or use wrong fallback value due to `or` operator.

**Failure scenario:** POST /sos with payload {"t": 0} - timestamp 0 is valid (line 95-96 only rejects negative), but `body.get("t") or body.get("ts")` treats 0 as falsy, falls through to None, returns BAD_REQUEST. With {"t": 0, "ts": 100}, wrong timestamp 100 is used.

**Verdict:** CONFIRMED
